description: Verify an EU trader's EORI number before shipping, invoicing or filing a customs declaration. Checks up to 10 EORI numbers (EU-27 and XI Northern Ireland) live against the European Commission's EORI validation service: valid or invalid, request date and, where the trader consented to publication, name and address. Malformed numbers are rejected free. GB EORIs are not covered. Use when customs paperwork or a shipment needs a confirmed EU EORI. $0.01 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

eori.description: One EORI number, or up to 10 separated by commas

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: check_eori
